QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to `private_x`. A field declared as `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(nr)` is really named `private_nr`, so `ctx.nr` fails to compile."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the macro renames the member so access fails at compile time. It never says the struct layout stays visible and sized, but the compile-time rename mechanism it describes is the substance of the item.
